name: Easybox
author: Easybox

sections.description: This plugin integrates your WordPress site with Easybox through the addition of custom components (widgets) for Elementor and Elementor Pro.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Search for the plugin by name (“easybox”) and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Easybox –> Authentication and login with your Easybox account.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Easybox account to use this plugin?

Yes. While the plugin itself can be activated, its functionalities only work once authenticated with Easybox. Reach out to Easybox to obtain your account.
